# Huion

> > Huion offers a comprehensive range of professional and beginner-friendly pen displays and pen tablets for digital artists, featuring advanced technologies like PenTech 4.0, Canvas Glass, and high-resolution 4K displays.

Huion is a leading manufacturer of creative input devices including pen displays (interactive tablets with screens) and pen tablets (drawing pads without screens). Their product lineup spans from entry-level devices for beginners to professional-grade displays with 4K resolution, high refresh rates, and advanced pressure sensitivity technology.

## Key Topics

- PenTech 4.0
- PenTech 3.0
- Canvas Glass
- 4K Display
- Pen Display
- Pen Tablet
- Pressure Sensitivity
- Bluetooth Connectivity
- Color Gamut
- sRGB
- Adobe RGB
- USB-C
- Digital Art
- Professional Graphics
- Beginner-Friendly
